description: Read-only MCP server for MuleSoft Anypoint: app logs, archive search, Runtime Manager, Exchange.
name: io.github.brbousnguar/mulewatch

environmentVariables.description: Anypoint connected app client id (app acts on its own behalf).
environmentVariables.name: ANYPOINT_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Business group id to operate on. Defaults to the organization the credentials belong to.
environmentVariables.name: ANYPOINT_ORG_ID

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated environment names or ids the server is allowed to read. Unset means all visible environments.
environmentVariables.name: ANYPOINT_ALLOWED_ENVIRONMENTS

environmentVariables.description: Anypoint control plane host. Defaults to https://anypoint.mulesoft.com.
environmentVariables.name: ANYPOINT_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Anypoint Monitoring host. Defaults to https://monitoring.anypoint.mulesoft.com.
environmentVariables.name: ANYPOINT_MONITORING_BASE_URL

title: mulewatch
